name: Generic AliExpress/CJ-to-Shopify dropshipping store
buyer: Impulse online shoppers reached via paid social
pain: Entrant wants a no-inventory store; shoppers want cheap novelty items fast

evidence.shows: Basic plan $39/mo monthly or $29/mo yearly; card rate 2.9%+30c online standard; 2% third-party gateway fee
Claims gross 30-50%, net 10-20%, $50 example 58% gross -> 4-6% net; CAC FB/IG $20-50, TikTok $15-40; apparel returns 20-30%, general 8-12%; chargebacks 1-2%
De minimis ended for China shipments 2025-11-01; duties 30-54% by category regardless of value

entrant_wedge: None identifiable: every dropshipper has same suppliers and tools.

entrant_edge.entrant_basis: model: no inventory; Shopify ~$29-39/mo plus ~$400 test ad budget. Available to every competitor, so not a differentiator.
entrant_edge.falsifier: If blended CAC >= gross profit per order (source cites CAC $20-50 on ~$50 AOV), edge is nil.

unit_economics.notes: Source-claimed net 4-6% on $50 example after ads; CAC $20-50 (unsourced vendor estimate); tariffs 30-54% on China-origin goods now apply to parcels

regulatory_or_platform_dependency: Shopify/payment processor terms; ad-platform policies; US customs duties on direct-from-China parcels
major_uncertainty: Whether any product/niche has CAC low enough; shipping times and returns from overseas suppliers

dimension_reasons.contribution_economics: Source-claimed net 4-6% to 10-20% after ads (vendor estimate)
dimension_reasons.demand_signal: Only vendor blogs with unsourced figures; no independent paying-behavior data verified
dimension_reasons.acquisition_efficiency: Paid ads CAC $20-50 per same vendor; no organic channel evidenced
dimension_reasons.automation: Order routing automatable but support/returns manual (inference)
dimension_reasons.capital_efficiency: ~$500 cash; unfavorable because ads are the sink
dimension_reasons.platform_resilience: Depends on Shopify, ad platforms, supplier
dimension_reasons.fulfillment_simplicity: Overseas shipping and 8-30%+ returns for apparel per source
dimension_reasons.regulatory_simplicity: Customs duties now apply, otherwise light

verdict_reason: Margins after CAC and now-applicable China duties are thin; no entrant edge since tooling is available to all.
unknowns: Independent (non-vendor) CAC and conversion data not verified

name: Niche personalized POD gifts on Etsy (pet memorial / specialty nursing / hobby journals)
buyer: Etsy gift shoppers in narrow niches
pain: Gift buyers want specific personalized items generic shops lack

evidence.shows: Etsy: $0.20 listing, 6.5% transaction, 3%+$0.25 processing, Offsite Ads 15% (<$10k yr sales) capped $100/order
Etsy POD GMV ~ $4.1B 2025 (+11%); $24.99 mug: gross 54.8%, 36.8% after Offsite Ads, ~28-32% after returns/etc.; generic designs saturated (one design ~4,200 sellers); niches with velocity listed
Reddit seller example: $17.68 sale, $10.61 production, $4.75 shipping = $2.32 profit (~13%, my calc); many sellers report ~20% net; some report 30-35%
Printful tee base $9.25-13.50 (Free plan), mug $5.95; Growth plan $24.99/mo

substitutes.name: Printify
substitutes.price_point: ~$7.50 tee/mug base (varies by provider, per UniLink)

entrant_wedge: Narrow-niche designs/keywords only; edge is research effort, not a structural advantage.

entrant_edge.entrant_basis: UniLink: realistic minimum $200-400 (listings, samples, tools); no inventory
entrant_edge.falsifier: If niche shops show net margin <15% after Offsite Ads/returns or <1 sale/week after 60 days, no viable business.

unit_economics.notes: UniLink mug example: ~28-32% realistic after returns; Mockey reddit example ~13%; Offsite Ads 15% on ad-driven sales

regulatory_or_platform_dependency: Etsy (single marketplace; fees/policies can change); POD supplier
major_uncertainty: Whether specific niche has demand not captured by top shops; design IP/AI-art policy not verified

dimension_reasons.demand_signal: Etsy POD GMV $4.1B (+11%) per one blog; no independent data verified
dimension_reasons.acquisition_efficiency: Etsy search organic but 15% Offsite Ads and saturation noted
dimension_reasons.competition_gap: Source says generic saturated; niche gap only claimed
dimension_reasons.launch_speed: Listings live in days; first sale uncertain
dimension_reasons.scale_without_hiring: Supplier fulfills; design labor scales with SKUs

verdict_reason: Modeled ~30% net at best on a saturated marketplace with commodity base cost and no structural entrant edge.
unknowns: AI-generated design policies on Etsy not verified

name: Thrift/estate-sale sourcing resold on eBay (vintage and branded)
buyer: eBay buyers of vintage/branded secondhand goods
pain: Buyers want specific secondhand items; entrant arbitrages local thrift pricing

evidence.shows: Final value fee 13.6% up to $7,500 plus $0.30 (<=$10) or $0.40 per order
Typical reseller net 30-50% of gross; 10-20% inventory never sells; 5-10% returns; ~$20/hr in one example ($1,024 net, 12h/wk); part-time 25-80 items/month

evidence.publisher: Retail Dive citing ThredUp 2026 Resale Report
evidence.shows: US secondhand apparel projected $78.8B by 2030, ~7.3% annual growth
US seller currency conversion charge rising 3% to 3.25% on 2026-10-14; seller platform terms set by eBay

entrant_wedge: No structural wedge; edge is sourcing skill and local access.

entrant_edge.entrant_basis: No improvement claimed; AI listing tools could cut drafting time but unverified
entrant_edge.falsifier: Any measured listing/photography time cut >30% from AI tooling would create edge; otherwise none.

unit_economics.notes: Source: net 30-50% of gross after COGS 20-40% and ~14% fees; mid-point model

regulatory_or_platform_dependency: eBay fee/policy changes; local thrift supply
major_uncertainty: Whether entrant sourcing yields >$8/hr; income range $500-2000/mo per source is unverified

dimension_reasons.contribution_economics: Source net 30-50%, but per-sale profit small
dimension_reasons.demand_signal: ThredUp growth data plus vendor blog; no eBay sell-through data verified
dimension_reasons.owner_time_efficiency: Source: 12h/wk for ~$1,000 net; scales with hours

verdict_reason: Labor-linear and low $/hr; no structural edge for an unknown entrant.

name: Amazon online/retail arbitrage and wholesale reselling
pain: Entrant buys discounted brand-name goods and resells on Amazon

evidence.shows: FBA fees rise avg $0.08/unit effective 2026-01-15
3P sellers >60% of Amazon sales; most sellers fail due to flawed math; fee rises: +$0.08 standard $10-50
Gated categories/brands need invoices, ODR<1%, late shipment <4%; Toys gated; brand examples gated

entrant_wedge: None: tools and sourcing are open to all; new accounts are gated.

entrant_edge.entrant_basis: model: ~$1,000 inventory + $39/mo Pro plan + prep; no source for arbitrage margins verified
entrant_edge.falsifier: If post-fee ROI <20% on a 20-item test buy, no edge.

unit_economics.notes: No verified arbitrage margin; Amazon referral 8-15% plus FBA fees; return processing $2-6/unit per Bebold

regulatory_or_platform_dependency: Amazon account health, brand/category gating, authenticity complaints
major_uncertainty: Arbitrage margins, sell-through, restrictions on new accounts; sellerboard source not read

dimension_reasons.contribution_economics: Unverified margin, fees and returns eat gap
dimension_reasons.demand_signal: Only vendor blog; no demand data for arbitrage

verdict_reason: Gated brands, single-platform risk, no verified margin or entrant edge.
unknowns: Sellerboard retail arbitrage 2026 article not read (session limit)

name: Private-label China-sourced Amazon kitchen gadget
buyer: Amazon shoppers seeking low-cost kitchen gadgets
pain: Entrant sources generic product and brands it

evidence.shows: Startup $3,000-10,000; inventory $1,000-3,000 for 200-500 units; PPC launch $300-800; referral 8-15%; return processing $2-6/unit; target 30-40% net
China tariffs 20-30%; $29.99 gadget net 32.8% (2023) to 24.9% after 2026 changes (vendor model); 12% ACoS assumption
Many launch at 20-30% gross before ads/returns; 3P sellers >60% of Amazon sales
FBA fees +$0.08/unit avg effective 2026-01-15

entrant_wedge: None: sourcing via marketplaces open to all.

entrant_edge.falsifier: Edge fails by construction; entrant spends same as others.

unit_economics.notes: SellerSprite vendor model: ~24.9% net after 2026 fees incl. 12% ACoS; excludes launch PPC and returns

regulatory_or_platform_dependency: Amazon fee/ban policies; US tariffs (reciprocal suspended through Nov 2026 per source)
major_uncertainty: Realistic launch ACoS far above 12% model; tariff rollback risk
verdict_reason: Thin modeled margin, upfront inventory, PPC dependence, no entrant edge.

name: 3D-printed original-design hobby organizers/accessories sold on Etsy
buyer: Hobbyists (tabletop gaming, cosplay, hobby organizers) on Etsy
pain: Niche hobby accessories are underserved by generic goods

evidence.shows: Bambu A1 Mini $299/Combo $449; PLA $15-20/kg; claimed 55-85% margins at $0.50-3 material; Etsy fees ~11-15%; part-timers $500-2,000/mo after 6-12 months; generic phone stands saturated
Since 2025-06-10 Etsy bans selling prints from third-party files even if licensed; own original designs allowed
Bambu A1 $339, A1 Combo $479, P1S $499 (expired promo)
Etsy 6.5% transaction + 3%+$0.25 + $0.20 listing; Offsite Ads 12-15%

entrant_wedge: Original CAD designs (AI-assisted CAD) in a narrow hobby; Etsy requires originality so asset-licensing competitors are barred.

entrant_edge.entrant_basis: A1 Mini Combo $449 plus ~$60 filament (StackSheriff prices); design effort own time
entrant_edge.falsifier: If Etsy demand for original designs yields <$500/mo after 6 months (source's own range lower bound), or listings are removed under the originality policy.

unit_economics.notes: Material $0.50-3 per print (source) plus ~14% Etsy fees plus packaging/postage (inference); source-claimed 55-85%; owner print/pack time excluded

regulatory_or_platform_dependency: Etsy originality policy since 2025-06-10; single marketplace; product-safety if marketed to children
major_uncertainty: Whether original designs sell at volume; printer time per unit; no $/hr measured

dimension_reasons.competition_gap: Source says generic saturated, niche gap claimed
dimension_reasons.platform_resilience: Etsy single channel, can sell direct

verdict_reason: Low capital and a policy that shuts out file-licence competitors; still marginal income, so deeper check needed.
unknowns: Printer throughput per day and actual sell-through not verified

name: Private-label natural skincare via contract manufacturer

evidence.shows: MoCRA small-business exemption under $1M avg sales avoids registration/listing/GMP; adverse event and safety/labeling apply; OTC drug products (sunscreen) excluded
Safety substantiation records required even for exempt; label needs ingredients and responsible-person contact since Dec 2024; registration effective 2024-07-01
Marketplace costs: referral 8-15%, return processing $2-6, startup $3k-10k, launch PPC $300-800 (general, not skincare-specific)

entrant_wedge: None: contract manufacturers sell same formulas to all.

entrant_edge.entrant_basis: no verified manufacturer MOQ pricing (fetch failed); assume same budget

unit_economics.notes: No verified per-unit cost or MOQ; demand and CAC not verified

regulatory_or_platform_dependency: FDA MoCRA labeling/adverse events/safety substantiation; contract manufacturer; marketplaces
major_uncertainty: MOQ, per-unit cost, CAC, demand not verified
verdict_reason: Compliance recordkeeping plus no entrant edge or verified economics.
unknowns: Manufacturer MOQ and unit price not verified
Competitor pricing and CAC not verified

name: Private-label children's/baby product (toys, plush, apparel accessories)
pain: Entrant brands a sourced children's item

evidence.shows: Toys (ASTM F963), small parts, lead, phthalates, apparel, sleepwear, etc. require CPSC-accepted lab testing; small batch relief only for some requirements
Typical testing $500-1,800 per product (simple $400-800; complex electronic $1,500-2,500); 1-3 weeks
Duties: toys 30-40%, textiles 40-54% for China shipments post-de minimis
Amazon Toys & Games is a gated category with holiday selling requirements

entrant_edge.entrant_basis: model: $3,000 base + ~$1,150 midpoint CPC lab test per product ($500-1,800)
entrant_edge.falsifier: Edge fails by construction; entrant cost is higher.

unit_economics.notes: Duties 30-40% toys; test $500-1,800 per product; no verified demand or margin

regulatory_or_platform_dependency: CPSIA/CPC, Amazon gating, tariffs; recall/liability exposure
major_uncertainty: Demand evidence and margin not collected (session limit)

dimension_reasons.contribution_economics: Duties plus testing cost per SKU depress margin
dimension_reasons.regulatory_simplicity: CPC, lab testing per SKU, recall exposure

verdict_reason: Per-SKU lab testing, duties, gated category, and liability for a no-edge entrant.
